reason: Retain below_threshold as an explicit report-level low-grade interpretation. The source directly grades both medial patellar facet and medial trochlea as isolated gradeI, without mixed II/III or deeper PF defect wording. Official ICRS grade1 and the primary study Outerbridge gradeI both describe superficial disease; the same report also pairs gradeI with cartilage signal alteration in tibial compartments, supporting consistent low-grade terminology without transferring tibial morphology to patella. Missing center identity does not by itself invalidate every numerical grade. This does not establish a named source center or exact report grading scale, and remains a weak-supervision inference rather than an image measurement.
